== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 26 July 2026. The Facebook photo viewer names Geert Van Slambrouck. A comment by Manuel Swaegemaekers is in Dutch. Identification: distinctive name plus Red 44 on the Decipher Squadron roster (Antwerpen, Bel). The Facebook profile is facebook.com/geert.vanslambrouck (Lives in Antwerp, Belgium; From Antwerp, Belgium; Upper Deck).
Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Geert Van Slambrouck portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Geert Van Slambrouck Facebook portrait.jpg]].
